title: SMOK TFV8 Baby Strip Coils
description: The TFV8 Baby Mesh coils from Smok are made for use with the TFV8 Baby Beast, Smok TFV8 Big Baby Beast and Smok TFV12 Baby Prince tanks. With an atomizer resistance of 0.15ohms, these coils are capable of huge cloud production and rich, pure flavour delivery. Vapestore is your go-to destination for SMOK products, including a premium collection of Smok E-cigarettes , high-quality Smok Tanks , innovative Mods , durable Smok Coils , and the newest Vape Kits .
